46f376.title: Altoro Mutual (demo.testfire.net) — FULL Endpoint & Attack-Surface Inventory
46f376.content:
# demo.testfire.net — Altoro Mutual (IBM/HCL AppScan demo banking app)

## Technology fingerprint
- Server header: `Apache-Coyote/1.1`; error pages expose `Apache Tomcat/7.0.92` (EOL, many CVEs).
- Java/JSP app. JAX-RS **Jersey** (`org.glassfish.jersey.servlet.ServletContainer`) powers `/api`.
- Stack traces leak package `com.ibm.security.appscan.altoromutual.*` → this is **AltoroJ** (open source: https://github.com/AppSecDev/AltoroJ/). Developers: `com.ibm.security.appscan.altoromutual.filter.AuthFilter` / `AdminFilter`.
- DB looks like **Apache Derby** (admin page leaks `SYS.SYSTABLES`, `SYSCOLUMNS`, `SYSSCHEMAS` etc.).
- **No WAF** (wafw00f: none).
- Session cookie `JSESSIONID` = `Path=/; HttpOnly` (no `Secure`, no `SameSite`). Extra cookie `AltoroAccounts` (base64, NOT HttpOnly, `Version=1`).

## Credentials
- **CONFIRMED**: `jsmith` / `demo1234` (works on web `POST /doLogin` AND `POST /api/login`). API accounts 800002–800023 + card 4539082039396288.
- Known/possible if untested only once: `admin`/`admin`. (jsmith IS able to use admin functions — see BFLA.)
- `/admin/admin.jsp` user dropdown **leaks usernames + passwords** (unverified), e.g. `pdata2attadmin:P@ssw0rd123:user`, `pdata1admin:admin_hacked:admin`, `pd2_13jsmith:demo1234:user`, `pdata4hackerman:hack123!:user`, `pd2_12jdoe:Hacked123!:user`, `pctuser:NewP@ss123:user`, `psspeedsspeed:Speed123!:user`, `pdata0adduser_baseline:test123:user`. Also plain users: admin, attadmin, blm912977_admin, jdoe, jsmith, sspeed, tuser, hackerman, testuser*.

## Confirmed web endpoints (from leaked web.xml + probing)
Public:
- `GET /` and `GET /index.jsp?content=<file>` — **`content` is a path-traversal sink** (see candidates). `index.jsp?content=privacy.htm` etc render content.
- `GET /default.aspx` → RedirectServlet; `GET /subscribe.aspx` → subscribe page.
- `GET /search.jsp?query=<q>` — reflects `query` in HTML.
- `GET /login.jsp`; `POST /doLogin` (**uid, passw, btnSubmit**) [LoginServlet]; `GET /logout.jsp`.
- `GET /feedback.jsp`; `POST /sendFeedback` (**name, email_addr, subject, comments, cfile=comments.txt[hidden]**) [FeedbackServlet]; GET→405.
- `GET /subscribe.jsp`; `POST /doSubscribe` (**txtEmail, btnSubmit**) [SubscribeServlet].
- `GET /status_check.jsp` (uses the SSRF-ish service below).
- `GET /util/serverStatusCheckService.jsp?HostName=<host>` — returns JSON {HostName,HostStatus:"OK"}. **SSRF candidate** (no diff observed; needs OOB validation).
- `GET /survey_questions.jsp?step=a|misc...`; `GET /static/doSurvey` (200), `POST /static/doSurvey` [SurveyServlet]; GET→405.
- `GET /disclaimer.htm?url=<u>` — JS reads `url=` and `window.location.href=sDst` → **DOM open redirect**.
- Swagger: `GET /swagger/index.html`, `GET /swagger/properties.json` (full OpenAPI), swagger-ui-*.js.
- Static: `/style.css`, `/images/*`, `/retirement.htm`, `/high_yield_investments.htm`.

Authenticated (bank console, AuthFilter):
- `GET /bank/main.jsp` (account summary: **showAccount** + logout links).
- `GET /bank/showAccount?listAccounts=<acct>` [AccountViewServlet] — **IDOR**.
- `GET/POST /bank/showTransactions` (**startDate, endDate**) [AccountViewServlet].
- `GET /bank/transfer.jsp`; `POST /bank/doTransfer` (**fromAccount, toAccount, transferAmount**) [TransferServlet].
- `GET /bank/transaction.jsp`.
- `GET /bank/ccApply`, `POST /bank/ccApply` [CCApplyServlet] (302→login unauth).
- `GET /bank/customize.jsp` (POST form).
- `GET /bank/queryxpath.jsp?content=queryxpath.jsp&query=<title>` — **XPath query sink** (news search).
- `GET /bank/stocks.jsp`; `GET /account.jsp`.

Admin:
- `GET /admin/admin.jsp` — admin console (Add Account / Change Password / Add User forms). **Guarded by AuthFilter only (login required), NOT AdminFilter** → any logged-in user reaches it.
- `POST /admin/addAccount`, `POST /admin/changePassword`, `POST /admin/addUser` [AdminServlet]; `POST /admin/doAdminLogin` [AdminLoginServlet].
- Filter config (from leaked web.xml): **AuthFilter on `/bank/*`, `/admin/*`, `/account.jsp`, servlets**; **AdminFilter only on the typo `/adimn/*`**. `/admin/*` unauthenticated → 302 login (every path, so existence is masked).

## REST API (basePath `/api`; Jersey; token in `Authorization: Bearer <tok>`)
- `GET /api/login` (checkLogin) → 401 `loggedIn=false` unauth.
- `POST /api/login` {username,password} → `{"Authorization":"<tok>","success":"... is now logged in"}`.
- `GET /api/account` → list of user's accounts (name+id).
- `GET /api/account/{accountNo}` → balance + credits/debits. **IDOR** (800001 not owned yet returned).
- `GET /api/account/{accountNo}/transactions`; `POST /api/account/{accountNo}/transactions` {startDate,endDate}.
- `POST /api/transfer` {toAccount,fromAccount,transferAmount} (401 unauth).
- `POST /api/feedback/submit` (public per spec).
- `GET /api/feedback/{feedbackId}` → 500 with full stack trace (info disclosure: Tomcat 7.0.92, Jersey, IBM package).
- `POST /api/admin/addUser`, `POST /api/admin/changePassword` → **BFLA: accept a regular user (jsmith) token** (401 without token). addUser created `reconprobe1`; changePassword accepted on `reconprobe_x`.
- `GET /api/logout` → `{"LoggedOut":"True"}`.

## Session / token model
- `AltoroAccounts` cookie = base64 of `acct~name~balance|...` for jsmith (e.g. `800002~Savings~-1.8999E27|...`), unsigned + NOT HttpOnly → client-side account data injection / tamper / render-XSS candidate.
- API token format: `base64( base64(user) ":" base64(pass) ) ":" <8 rand bytes>` → predictable/forgeable structure candidate; no visible expiry.
- `logout.jsp` → 302 index; `GET /api/logout` returns True (token may remain valid afterwards — needs validation).

## HTML comment hints
- `login.jsp`: `<!-- To get the latest admin login, please contact SiteOps at 415-555-6159 -->`
- `feedback.jsp`: `Re-generated every Tuesday and old files are saved to .bak format at L:\backup\website\oldfiles` (internal path disclosure)
- `showAccount`: `<!-- To modify account information do not connect to SQL source directly. ... -->`

429b77.title: demo.testfire.net — HIGH-VALUE candidate surfaces (confirmed by recon, PENDING formal reports)
429b77.content:
All items below were reproduced during black-box recon. They are NOT yet filed as reports — downstream VALIDATION + REPORTING agents should confirm/expand and file.

1. **Path traversal / arbitrary local file read** — `GET /index.jsp?content=../WEB-INF/web.xml` returned the full 14141-byte `web.xml` (servlet mappings, filters). Only one `../` level works (deeper → 500). Also confirms `/index.jsp?content=../index.jsp` (recurses, 6 MB). Sink = `content` param in index/default.jsp include. READ-ONLY PoC. Impact: read config/secrets/source. Likely **Critical/High**.
2. **Broken Function Level Authorization (privilege escalation)** — regular user `jsmith` calls admin-only functions:
   - `POST /api/admin/addUser` and `POST /api/admin/changePassword` (401 without token, 200 "success" WITH jsmith token) → created `reconprobe1`.
   - Web `/admin/admin.jsp` console is behind AuthFilter only (AdminFilter is on the typo `/adimn/*`). Any logged-in user can add users / change passwords via `POST /admin/addUser` etc. Likely **High/Critical**.
3. **IDOR (horizontal)** — `GET /api/account/800001` (not in jsmith's 800002–800023 list) returns balance+transactions; `GET /bank/showAccount?listAccounts=800001` shows "Account History - 800001"; `listAccounts=800010` returns 79903 bytes. Likely **High**.
4. **Sensitive data / credential disclosure** — `GET /admin/admin.jsp` user `<select>` leaks many usernames WITH passwords embedded (e.g. `pdata2attadmin:P@ssw0rd123:user`, `pdata1admin:admin_hacked:admin`) and DB schema/rows (Derby `SYS.*` tables, PEOPLE columns incl `PASSWORD`, `TOTP_SECRET`; ACCOUNTS rows). Likely **High**.
5. **XPath injection** — `GET /bank/queryxpath.jsp?content=queryxpath.jsp&query=Watchfire` performs XPath; quote input handled — needs blind/boolean exploitation. **Medium/High**.
6. **SQL injection candidates** — `POST /doLogin uid`, `GET /search.jsp?query`, `POST /api/login`, account/transaction params. Not yet proven.
7. **SSRF** — `GET /util/serverStatusCheckService.jsp?HostName=` returned static "OK" for valid/invalid/malformed hosts with no timing/response differential → needs **OOB (interactsh)** proof to confirm blind SSRF.
8. **DOM open redirect** — `GET /disclaimer.htm?url=http://evil/` (go() sets window.location href). Low/Medium (phishing pivot).
9. **Cookie tampering / render XSS** — `AltoroAccounts` base64 cookie (unsigned, non-HttpOnly) parsed for account name/balance display.
10. **API token structure** — token is deterministic-base64 of creds + 8 random bytes; test forge/replay + whether logout invalidates.
11. **Arbitrary file write candidate** — `POST /sendFeedback` hidden `cfile=comments.txt` param.
12. **Default creds** — jsmith/demo1234 confirmed; admin/admin documented.
13. **Info disclosure** — `/api/feedback/{id}` 500 leaks Tomcat 7.0.92 + full stack traces; `login.jsp`/`feedback.jsp` HTML comments.

NOTE: A test user `reconprobe1` was created (and password change attempted on non-existent `reconprobe_x`) to confirm BFLA — no existing/production data modified.

a94809.title: Recon methodology & tooling — demo.testfire.net
a94809.content:
Black-box recon approach (single in-scope target http://demo.testfire.net only):
1. Fingerprint: curl headers, error pages (Tomcat version via /api/feedback/1 500 stack trace), wafw00f (no WAF).
2. Crawl: katana depth 3 (`-d 3 -jc -kf robotstxt`), bounded; extracted URL list then removed raw JSON. gospider not needed (katana coverage was complete).
3. Content discovery: dirsearch (jsp/do/action/... ) — low yield because /admin/* returns 302 to login for every path; stopped early.
4. Manual enumeration of the authenticated bank console (cookie jar login via POST /doLogin), API mapping with the Bearer token from POST /api/login, and Swagger spec (/swagger/properties.json) as the authoritative API map.
5. web.xml disclosure via /index.jsp?content=../WEB-INF/web.xml supplied the definitive servlet + filter mapping list.
6. Read-only PoCs only; no destructive actions. One test user (reconprobe1) created via BFLA to confirm privileged function access.
Key artifacts (bounded, in /workspace/recon): katana_urls.txt, webxml_leak.xml, robots.txt, headers_login.txt, dirsearch.txt.
Deliverable for downstream: full inventory note + high-value candidate note.

0eecc1.title: SSRF at serverStatusCheckService.jsp RULED OUT; reflected XSS found instead
0eecc1.content:
**Surface:** `GET /util/serverStatusCheckService.jsp?HostName=<host>` (also reachable via `/status_check.jsp`).

**SSRF:** RULED OUT. Source (`WebContent/util/serverStatusCheckService.jsp`, AltoroJ) is a 4-line JSP that only echoes the parameter into a JSON literal with a hardcoded `"HostStatus": "OK"`. No server-side HTTP fetch anywhere in the codebase. No behavioral/timing differential across valid/internal/external/malformed/empty values, and an interactsh OOB payload produced no callback. The "check" is client-side JS only. Coverage `edd7bc` moved to `ruled_out`.

**Reflected XSS:** CONFIRMED and filed as **vuln-0001** (Medium, CVSS 6.1). `HostName` is reflected unescaped into a `text/html` response; `<script>` executes in-browser (verified live). No CSP/nosniff. Coverage `4cdeb7` = reported. Fix: encode with `ServletUtil.sanitizeWeb` and/or serve `application/json`.

**Still worth checking (not done here):** other URL-fetch/consumer features — `POST /doSubscribe` (`txtEmail`), `/sendFeedback` hidden `cfile` — were grep-checked for server-side fetch sinks and none exist in source; they are out of scope for SSRF.

54883e.title: Source available: /workspace/AltoroJ (AltoroJ demo app source) — use for root-cause & fix
54883e.content:
The AltoroJ application source is present in the workspace at `/workspace/AltoroJ` (obtained during testing). Web root is `WebContent/`, Java under `src/com/ibm/security/appscan/altoromutual/` (servlets, filters AuthFilter/AdminFilter, api/*.java, util/*.java). Use it to:
- confirm root causes and derive concrete inline fixes (code_locations fix_before/fix_after + fix_pr_body + fix_verification) for any finding that is still black-box-only.
- trace source->sink for taint (e.g. index.jsp `content` include, queryxpath XPath service, doLogin/search SQL, admin console JSP credential dump).
- grep for hardcoded secrets/DB creds (WEB-INF/web.xml context params, DBUtil) that a black-box read could not reach.

Agents already cross-referencing: SSRF agent (ruled out via source: no server-side fetch), IDOR agent (AccountAPI.java:63 comment "not checking the account number, side privilege escalation possible"). Report as white-box where source grounds it.

2c2fbd.title: BFLA validated: jsmith → admin functions (vuln-0005)
2c2fbd.content:
Independently validated the recon BFLA candidate and filed **vuln-0005** (High, CVSS 8.1, CWE-862).

Confirmed root cause (leaked web.xml + public AltoroJ source): `AuthFilter` → `/admin/*` (login only); `AdminFilter` → typo `/adimn/*` so the role check (`user.getRole()==Role.Admin`) never runs. `AdminServlet` has no role check. API `ApiAuthFilter` only validates the token, not the role.

Demonstrated impact as jsmith (non-admin, no ADMINISTRATION link in UI):
- `POST /admin/addUser` → creates a real user that then authenticates (302 → user appears in PEOPLE / admin user list).
- `POST /admin/changePassword` username=test_normal_abc → login as that non-owned account with attacker-set pw (takeover).
- `POST /admin/addAccount` → added accounts 800026, 800027 to jsmith.
- `GET /admin/admin.jsp` → 200 (admin console); API `/api/admin/*` → 401 unauth vs 200 with jsmith token.

IMPORTANT gotcha for other agents: both login paths (`LoginServlet`, `LoginAPI`) call `password.trim().toLowerCase()`, and `DBUtil.isValidUser` only special-cases jsmith/demo1234. So a NEW user or a changed password only works if the password is ALL LOWERCASE — otherwise the created/reset credential appears to "not work" (endpoint looks like a no-op). Also `DBUtil.addUser`/`changePassword` via the API are gated on `enableAdminFunctions` (currently false → API returns fake success with no write); the web `AdminServlet` path is NOT gated and does write.

Test artifacts created in the demo bank: users bflagh_7hez7, evprobe_y3ued, svcprobe_l28cz, webprobe_zz1, msgprobe_zz9; accounts 800026, 800027; and test_normal_abc's password was reset (original unknown). Synthetic demo data.

Source reference cloned at /workspace/AltoroJ (fix for web.xml applied+XML-verified there).

162faf.title: Client-side/session/CSRF test results (agent d3ee5c1d)
162faf.content:
## Confirmed (reports filed)
1. **SQLi auth bypass in POST /api/login (username)** — CRITICAL → vuln-0009. `{"username":"admin'-- ","password":"x"}` → 200 + token for admin (no password needed); token returns admin accounts 800000/800001/800009/800025. Control `admin`/`WRONGPASS` → 400. Derby backend.
2. **API bearer token design** — LOW → vuln-0013. `base64(base64(user):base64(pass):<8 rand>)`; trailing signature NOT validated (empty/garbage accepted); **plaintext password recoverable** from token (verified reuse on /doLogin); `GET /api/logout` returns LoggedOut:True but token still valid (replay 200); no expiry/revocation.
3. **DOM XSS + open redirect `/disclaimer.htm?url=`** — MEDIUM → vuln-0017. Click "OK" → go() assigns url to location.href with no scheme check. `?url=javascript:document.title=1` → title becomes 1; `?url=javascript:document.body.setAttribute%28%27data-y%27%2C%27OK9%27%29` → body attr data-y=OK9 (arbitrary origin script exec); `?url=http://example.com/` → navigates to https://example.com/. Body reflection is encodeURI'd (not the sink).

## Ruled out
- **AltoroAccounts cookie tampering**: unsigned/non-HttpOnly base64 of acct~name~balance, but tampered balances/names are NOT reflected into any server-rendered page (main.jsp/showAccount use session data). No spoofing/XSS impact.
- **CSRF on state-changing web forms** (doTransfer, /admin/addUser, /admin/changePassword, sendFeedback, doSubscribe): no anti-CSRF tokens and server ignores Origin/Referer (forged-Origin POST executed server-side), BUT empirical Chromium test — cross-origin top-level POST to /admin/addUser did NOT include JSESSIONID (only AltoroAccounts was sent) → 302 to /login.jsp, action did not execute. SameSite=Lax-by-default blocks it. Not exploitable in modern browsers. GET variants return 405 / no state change.
- **API CSRF/CORS**: /api/* auth is Authorization-header only (401 with cookies); no ACAO reflection → not CSRF-able.

## Open handoffs
- /api/login SQLi overlaps SQLi coverage 5d1335 — dedup will reconcile if the SQLi agent files it.
- SSRF (interactsh), XPath injection, path traversal: other agents' lanes, untouched here.

31e689.title: CLOSED: sendFeedback `cfile` is a dead parameter — NOT arbitrary file write / RCE
31e689.content:
Resolves recon candidate #11 (note 429b77) and coverage a38b44.

**Verdict: ruled out (not RCE, not arbitrary file write).**

Source (AltoroJ 3.2 @ /workspace/AltoroJ):
- `FeedbackServlet.doPost` (src/com/ibm/security/appscan/altoromutual/servlet/FeedbackServlet.java:47-67) reads only `name`, `email_addr`, `subject`, `comments`. It never calls `request.getParameter("cfile")`.
- `OperationsUtil.sendFeedback` -> `DBUtil.storeFeedback` (DBUtil.java:520-529) = `INSERT INTO FEEDBACK(...)` SQL statement. No filesystem write.
- `cfile` exists ONLY as a dead hidden input at WebContent/feedback.jsp:50. No other reference in src/ or WebContent/.
- No upload/multipart support anywhere (no @MultipartConfig / getPart / ServletFileUpload / DiskFileItem).

Dynamic (http://demo.testfire.net):
- 11 distinct `cfile` values (comments.txt; probe_up.txt; ../WebContent/..; ../WEB-INF/..; ../../..; /tmp/..; *.jsp variants) all returned a byte-identical 200 "Thank You" (7029 bytes).
- Unique marker unreadable at /probe_up.txt, /probe_up.jsp, /comments.txt (404) or via traversal /index.jsp?content=../<file>.

Other write sinks audited: only ServletUtil.java:396 (fixed path swagger/properties.json, server-derived content) and log init — neither user-controlled.

Coverage: a38b44 -> ruled_out; e50b53 (/api/feedback/submit) -> no_issue_found; caa675 (all app file-write sinks) -> no_issue_found.

97fb45.title: Residual gaps closed — feedback stored-XSS (ruled out), vuln-0015 cross-user (confirmed→High), ccApply field manipulation (ruled out)
97fb45.content:
Three previously-open items on demo.testfire.net were closed and their existing coverage entries updated (no new rows).

## 1. Stored feedback render sink — RULED OUT (coverage 5f19c3)
Source has genuine unescaped sinks: WebContent/admin/feedbackReview.jsp:47-63 (all rows) and WebContent/feedbacksuccess.jsp:74-86 (submitted row) both emit `name/email/subject/message` via raw `<%= %>`. BUT both are gated by `ServletUtil.isAppPropertyTrue("enableFeedbackRetention")` (feedbackReview.jsp:33, feedbacksuccess.jsp:51), and the property is FALSE in the deployed app. Write oracle: `POST /api/feedback/submit` returns the JSON echo branch `{name,email,subject,comments}` and NOT `{"status":"Thank you!","feedbackId":...}`; per OperationsUtil.sendFeedback (OperationsUtil.java:122-131) the id is returned only when the property is true, so DBUtil.storeFeedback is never called and the FEEDBACK table is never written. `/admin/feedbackReview.jsp` reachable (200) but renders no "Customer feedback submissions" block; `/sendFeedback` -> feedbacksuccess.jsp renders no "Details of your feedback submission". No other page renders feedback (grep). No stored file to read via traversal — feedback is DB-backed. Latent note: if an operator sets enableFeedbackRetention=true, feedbackReview.jsp/fresh feedbacksuccess.jsp become stored-XSS sinks (no encoding on the render path) — an intentional demo feature, not reportable on the current deployment.

## 2. vuln-0015 stored XSS — CROSS-USER CONFIRMED → raised to High (CVSS 7.6) (coverage 38962d)
Payload stored by one account via POST /admin/addUser executes in a DIFFERENT account's session. Key gotcha confirmed: LoginServlet (LoginServlet.java:80) lower-cases the password (`passw.trim().toLowerCase()`) before DBUtil.isValidUser, so second accounts MUST be created with all-lowercase passwords — that is why the original tester's mixed-case accounts never authenticated. Created victim `rgvictim1`/`rgpass123`, authenticated, loaded /admin/admin.jsp: live eval returned `window.__storedXss=778899` and 6 `img[onerror]` elements in the victim DOM. Control: unauthenticated /admin/admin.jsp -> 302 /login.jsp. Render is global (getBankUsers = SELECT USER_ID FROM PEOPLE; admin.jsp:90 and :126). vuln-0015 revised (not re-filed).

## 3. /bank/ccApply field/parameter manipulation — RULED OUT (coverage 34a3de)
CCApplyServlet reads exactly ONE param, `passwd` (CCApplyServlet.java:47). No mass assignment possible. Live: GET -> 405; POST no passwd -> 500 (NPE at passwd.trim()); POST passwd=demo1234 -> 200 applysuccess; POST passwd=wrong -> 200 apply.jsp "Login Failed". Only sink is passwd -> DBUtil.isValidUser (already reported as vuln-0009); no state change even on success => no distinct impact.

No new vulnerability reports filed.
